name: org.specsource/specsource
title: SpecSource
description: Verified electronics spec data with a source and check date for every product. Read-only.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Filters verified products in one category by spec values (for example watts, weight, ports, capacity) and returns up to 10, each with its source URL and check date. Numeric filters use min/max objects keyed by field name; yes/no filters use flags. Every response lists the fields that category can be filtered and sorted on. Products with an unknown value for a filtered field are left out. Recalled products are not included.

category.description: Required. The one product category to search, as a slug. One of: "chargers", "power-banks", "usb-c-cables", "mini-pcs", "kvm-switches", "usb-c-docks", "ssds", "nas", "wireless-chargers", "monitors", "memory", "power-supplies", "cpu-coolers", "graphics-cards", "video-cables", "ethernet-cables", "pc-power-cables", "usb-cables". Example: "chargers".

brand.description: Optional. Brand name, matched exactly but ignoring case and spacing. Up to 60 characters. No default (all brands). Example: "Anker" or "UGREEN".

query.description: Optional. Space-separated words that must all appear in the product name, model number or other model numbers; case is ignored. Up to 120 characters. No default. Example: "Prime 160W" or "A2687".

min.description: Optional. Minimum values as an object of {numeric field name: number}; a product passes when the field is at least that number. Field names end in their unit (_w watts, _g grams, _mm millimetres, _mah, _gbps). Valid names depend on the category and are listed in every response under filterable_fields.numeric. Products with no value for the field are excluded. Example: {"total_output_w": 100, "usb_c_ports": 2}.

max.description: Optional. Maximum values as an object of {numeric field name: number}; a product passes when the field is at most that number. Same field names as min. Products with no value for the field are excluded. Example: {"weight_g": 300}.

flags.description: Optional. Yes/no conditions as an object of {boolean field name: true or false}. Valid names depend on the category and are listed in every response under filterable_fields.yes_no. Example: {"pd31_epr": true} for chargers, {"flight_ok": true} for power banks.

sort_by.description: Optional. One numeric field name to sort results by (same names as min and max). Products with no value for that field are left out when sorting. No default: without it, results keep the site's own order. Example: "weight_g".

order.description: Sort direction when sort_by is set: "asc" (smallest first) or "desc" (largest first). Default "asc". Example: "desc" with sort_by "total_output_w" for the most powerful first.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return: a whole number from 1 to 10. Default 10. The response also gives total_matches. Example: 5.

lang.description: Language of text fields (notes, labels, answers). One of: "en" (English), "zh-hant" (Traditional Chinese), "zh-hans" (Simplified Chinese). Default "en". Spec values and model numbers are the same in every language. Example: "zh-hant".

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Returns the full verified spec record for one product, looked up by slug, model number, other model number or name, with its source URL and check date. Recalled power banks are returned with their recall notice.

product.description: Required. The product to look up: its slug, model number, another model number it is sold under, or words from its name (1 to 120 characters, case ignored). If more than one product matches, the error lists the candidates. Example: "A2687", "anker-prime-160w" or "Anker Prime 160W".

category.description: Optional. Limits the lookup to one category, for when a model number or name matches products in more than one. One of: "chargers", "power-banks", "usb-c-cables", "mini-pcs", "kvm-switches", "usb-c-docks", "ssds", "nas", "wireless-chargers", "monitors", "memory", "power-supplies", "cpu-coolers", "graphics-cards", "video-cables", "ethernet-cables", "pc-power-cables", "usb-cables". No default (all categories). Example: "chargers".

lang.description: Language of text fields (notes, labels, answers). One of: "en" (English), "zh-hant" (Traditional Chinese), "zh-hans" (Simplified Chinese). Default "en". Spec values and model numbers are the same in every language. Example: "zh-hant".

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Puts 2 to 4 verified products from the same category side by side and lists the spec fields where they differ. Each product keeps its own source URL and check date.

products.description: Required. A list of 2 to 4 products from the same category, each given as a slug, model number or words from its name (1 to 120 characters each). The same product cannot appear twice. Example: ["A2687", "A2340"].

category.description: Optional. Limits each lookup to one category, for when a model number matches products in more than one. One of: "chargers", "power-banks", "usb-c-cables", "mini-pcs", "kvm-switches", "usb-c-docks", "ssds", "nas", "wireless-chargers", "monitors", "memory", "power-supplies", "cpu-coolers", "graphics-cards", "video-cables", "ethernet-cables", "pc-power-cables", "usb-cables". No default. Example: "power-banks".

lang.description: Language of text fields (notes, labels, answers). One of: "en" (English), "zh-hant" (Traditional Chinese), "zh-hans" (Simplified Chinese). Default "en". Spec values and model numbers are the same in every language. Example: "zh-hant".

tools.name: find_gear_for_device
tools.description: Given the devices someone uses (laptops, phones, desktops, monitors), finds verified chargers, carry-on power banks, cables, KVM switches and USB-C docks whose specs cover them. Uses the same rules as the SpecSource /setup tool and returns up to 2 products per kind (10 in total).

type.description: Required. Kind of device: "laptop", "phone" (phones and tablets), "desktop" or "monitor". Laptops and phones are charged; desktops count toward KVM switches; monitors decide KVM switches and docks. Example: "laptop".

preset.description: Optional. A known device model, which sets its charging watts and whether it is a Mac. One of: "macbook-air", "macbook-pro-14", "macbook-pro-16", "windows-laptop-65w", "windows-laptop-100w", "other-laptop", "phone", "tablet", "other-phone", "mac-mini", "mac-studio", "mini-pc", "desktop-tower". Must match type (laptop presets for laptops, and so on). No default. Example: "macbook-pro-16" (140W).

watts.description: Optional for laptops and phones (required if no preset gives a wattage). The charging watts the device can draw, a number from 5 to 240; overrides the preset. Ignored for desktops and monitors. Example: 65.

resolution.description: Optional, monitors only. Highest resolution the monitor runs at: "1080p", "1440p", "4k" or "5k" (5K or more). Default "4k". Example: "1440p".

inputs.description: Optional, monitors only. The video inputs the monitor has, as a list of "HDMI", "DisplayPort" and "USB-C". A USB-C input means the cable must carry video. Default ["HDMI"]. Example: ["HDMI", "USB-C"].

devices.description: Required. The devices to cover, 1 to 20, each an object with type and optional preset, watts, resolution and inputs. Example: [{"type": "laptop", "preset": "macbook-pro-16"}, {"type": "phone", "watts": 30}, {"type": "monitor", "resolution": "4k", "inputs": ["USB-C"]}].

lang.description: Language of text fields (notes, labels, answers). One of: "en" (English), "zh-hant" (Traditional Chinese), "zh-hans" (Simplified Chinese). Default "en". Spec values and model numbers are the same in every language. Example: "zh-hant".

tools.name: check_power_bank_flight
tools.description: Says whether a verified power bank can go in carry-on luggage, based only on the Wh rating the brand states (under 100Wh: no airline approval needed). Recalled models always return "recalled, do not fly". Includes the rule used and the product source.

product.description: Required. The power bank to check: its slug, model number, another model number it is sold under, or words from its name (1 to 120 characters, case ignored). Products from other categories are rejected. Example: "A1695" or "Anker Prime 20K".

lang.description: Language of text fields (notes, labels, answers). One of: "en" (English), "zh-hant" (Traditional Chinese), "zh-hans" (Simplified Chinese). Default "en". Spec values and model numbers are the same in every language. Example: "zh-hant".

tools.name: check_spec_claim
tools.description: Looks up recorded spec disputes: where a brand figure and other sources disagree (for example total watts or capacity), with every figure, its condition and its own source URL, and which figure SpecSource adopted (settled) or that it is still open. Search by product or by words in the question.

product.description: Optional. The product whose claims to look up: slug, model number or words from its name (1 to 120 characters, case ignored). At least one of product, query or category is required. Example: "PB200U" or "CUKTECH 15 Ultra".

query.description: Optional. Space-separated words (2 to 120 characters) that must all appear in the claim's question, answer, reason or figures, in any of the three languages. Example: "210W" or "TBW".

category.description: Optional. Only claims in this category. One of: "chargers", "power-banks", "usb-c-cables", "mini-pcs", "kvm-switches", "usb-c-docks", "ssds", "nas", "wireless-chargers", "monitors", "memory", "power-supplies", "cpu-coolers", "graphics-cards", "video-cables", "ethernet-cables", "pc-power-cables", "usb-cables". Can be used alone to list a category's claims (up to 10). Example: "ssds".

lang.description: Language of text fields (notes, labels, answers). One of: "en" (English), "zh-hant" (Traditional Chinese), "zh-hans" (Simplified Chinese). Default "en". Spec values and model numbers are the same in every language. Example: "zh-hant".

tools.name: find_same_product
tools.description: Finds other model numbers a verified product is sold under (same specs, different region, retailer or color), with the source for each model number.

product.description: Required. The product to look up: slug, model number, another model number, or words from its name (1 to 120 characters, case ignored). Example: "35527" or "PB771".

lang.description: Language of text fields (notes, labels, answers). One of: "en" (English), "zh-hant" (Traditional Chinese), "zh-hans" (Simplified Chinese). Default "en". Spec values and model numbers are the same in every language. Example: "zh-hant".
